1: At the start of the summer season, the price x of a pair of sandals was increased by 20%. After a month, the new price was decreased by 10%. After both changes the sandals cost 81 zł. Options: A. 45 zł B. 73.63 zł C. 75 zł D. 87.48 zł. Find the initial price x of the pair of sandals.
3: The number $\log_{\sqrt3}9$ equals: A. 2 B. 3 C. 4 D. 9.
6: The largest real solution of the equation $x(x+2)(x^2+9)=0$ is: A. -2 B. 0 C. 2 D. 3.
7: In the set of real numbers, the equation $\frac{x+1}{(x+2)(x-3)}=0$: A. has no solution. B. has exactly one solution: -1. C. has exactly two solutions: -2 and 3. D. has exactly three solutions: -1, -2 and 3.
9: The arithmetic mean of three numbers a, b, c equals 9. The arithmetic mean of the six numbers a, a, b, b, c, c equals: A. 9 B. 6 C. 4.5 D. 18.
13: The linear functions f and g, given by f(x) = 3x + 6 and g(x) = ax + 7, have the same zero. The coefficient a in the formula of g equals: A. -7/2 B. -2/7 C. 2/7 D. 7/2.
16: In the arithmetic sequence $(a_n)$, defined for every natural number $n\ge1$, $a_4=-2$ and $a_6=16$. The fifth term of this sequence equals: A. 7/2 B. 9/2 C. 7 D. 9.
17: The geometric sequence $(a_n)$ is given by $a_n = 2^{n-1}$ for every natural number $n \ge 1$. The common ratio of this sequence equals: A. 1/2 B. -2 C. 2 D. 1.
18: The sequence $(b_n)$ is given by $b_n = (n+2)(7-n)$ for every natural number $n \ge 1$. The number of positive terms of this sequence equals: A. 6 B. 7 C. 8 D. 9.
19: The number $\sin^3 20° + \cos^2 20° \cdot \sin 20°$ equals: A. $\cos 20°$ B. $\sin 20°$ C. $\tan 20°$ D. $\sin 20° \cdot \cos 20°$.
20: The angle $\alpha$ is acute and $\cos\alpha = 5/13$. Then: A. $\tan\alpha=12/13$ B. $\tan\alpha=12/5$ C. $\tan\alpha=5/12$ D. $\tan\alpha=13/12$.
21: A parallelogram has sides of length 3 and 4, with the angle between them measuring 120°. The area of this parallelogram equals: A. 6 B. $6\sqrt3$ C. 12 D. $12\sqrt3$.
22: In triangle MKC, side MK has length 24. A line parallel to MK intersects sides MC and KC at points A and B respectively, such that |AB| = 6 and |AC| = 3 [Figure: triangle MKC with segment AB parallel to MK, near vertex C, forming a smaller similar triangle ABC]. The length of segment MA equals: A. 18 B. 15 C. 9 D. 12.
23: In triangle ABC, inscribed in a circle with center S, angle ACB measures 42° [Figure: circle with inscribed triangle ABC and center S, segment AS drawn]. The measure of the acute angle BAS equals: A. 42° B. 45° C. 48° D. 69°.
24: Lines k and l are given by k: y = (m+1)x + 7 and l: y = -2x + 7. Lines k and l are perpendicular when the number m equals: A. -1/2 B. 1/2 C. -3 D. 1.
25: On line l, which has slope 1/2, lie points A = (2, -4) and B = (0, b). Then the number b equals: A. -5 B. 10 C. -2 D. 0.
26: The height of a regular hexagonal prism equals 6 [Figure: hexagonal prism with height 6 marked]. The base area of this prism equals $15\sqrt3$. The area of one lateral face of this prism equals: A. $36\sqrt{10}$ B. 60 C. $6\sqrt{10}$ D. 360.
28: The volume of a regular quadrilateral pyramid equals 64. The height of this pyramid equals 12. The length of the base edge of this pyramid equals: A. 2 B. 4 C. 6 D. 8.
29: We consider all four-digit codes formed only from the digits 1, 3, 6, 8, where each of these digits appears exactly once in each code. The number of all such codes equals: A. 4 B. 10 C. 24 D. 16.
32: The axis of symmetry of the graph of the quadratic function $f(x) = x^2 + bx + c$ is the line $x = -2$. One of the zeros of f is the number 1. Compute the coefficients b and c.
33: The arithmetic sequence $(a_n)$ is defined for every natural number $n \ge 1$. The third term of this sequence equals -1, and the sum of the first fifteen consecutive terms of this sequence equals -165. Compute the common difference of this sequence.
34: In parallelogram ABCD, A = (-2, 6) and B = (10, 2). The diagonals AC and BD of this parallelogram intersect at point P = (6, 7). Compute the length of side BC of this parallelogram.
35: Given is the five-element set $K = \{5, 6, 7, 8, 9\}$. Drawing each number from this set is equally likely. From set K we draw, with replacement, one number at a time, twice in a row, and record them in the order drawn. Compute the probability of event A, that the sum of the drawn numbers is an even number.
36: In a regular quadrilateral prism with volume equal to 108, the ratio of the base edge length to the height of the prism equals 1/4. The diagonal of this prism is inclined to the base plane at angle $\alpha$ [Figure: prism with the angle $\alpha$ between its space diagonal and the base plane marked]. Compute the cosine of angle $\alpha$ and the total surface area of this prism.
